I have some schooling, so I look at cost and what I saw around me last season. This beans plot is very small, only 0.08 ha, so I will not buy chemical fertilizer just for it; I will use a little manure from home and keep cash for the bigger plots. If I can get improved bean seed in a small amount through the cooperative or from another farmer, I will plant that, and my family will handle the work without hiring.
